# Enhanced Tmux-Orchestrator
**Autonomous AI Development Orchestration with Leadership Hierarchy**
Combines Tmux-Orchestrator + Claude Flow + Spec-Driven Development + Vibe Kanban + Cortex Memory for comprehensive 24/7 autonomous development with enterprise-grade monitoring and proper leadership structure.
## 🏗️ System Architecture
### Leadership Hierarchy ``` Master Orchestrator (Always Running) ├── Meta-coordination across all workflows ├── Resource allocation and capacity management ├── Strategic decision-making and priority setting └── System health monitoring and optimization
Workflow Coordinators (Per Workflow Instance) ├── Workflow-specific leadership and coordination ├── Phase gate management and approval ├── Agent team management and performance ├── Stakeholder communication and reporting └── Quality assurance and deliverable validation
Specialized Managers (Per Domain) ├── Technical Lead (Architecture decisions) ├── Project Manager (Timeline and resources) ├── Scrum Master (Process and ceremonies) ├── Product Owner (Requirements and priorities) └── DevOps Manager (Infrastructure and deployment) ```
### Core Components ``` Vibe Kanban Dashboard (Progress Monitoring) ├── GitHub Integration (Issues/PRs/Projects) ├── Multi-Agent Task Tracking └── Real-time Progress Updates
Enhanced Tmux-Orchestrator (Agent Management) ├── Spec-Driven 5-Phase Workflows ├── 20 Specialized Workflow Types ├── Dynamic Agent Teams with Leadership └── Claude Flow MCP Tools (87)
Cortex Memory Backend (Persistence) ├── Cross-Session State Management ├── Agent Learning & Patterns ├── Specification History └── Progress Analytics ```
## 🚀 20 Specialized Workflows (All with Leadership)
### Core Development Workflows 1. **hivemind** - Multi-agent coordination with queen leadership 2. **swarm** - Parallel task execution with load balancing 3. **deep-research** - Context7 + sequential thinking integration 4. **code-review** - Security + quality analysis pipeline 5. **refactor** - Architecture improvement with safety checks
### Specialized Development Workflows 6. **documentation-generation** - Comprehensive docs with EARS requirements 7. **security-audit** - Full security analysis following EARS specifications 8. **performance-optimization** - Benchmarking and optimization with measurable criteria 9. **deployment-pipeline** - CI/CD with spec-driven gate approvals 10. **testing-automation** - Test suite creation with TDD validation
### Advanced Workflows 11. **api-development** - REST/GraphQL with EARS API contracts 12. **database-design** - Schema design with specification-driven constraints 13. **monitoring-setup** - Observability with measurable SLA requirements 14. **containerization** - Docker/K8s with spec-driven deployment criteria 15. **integration-testing** - Cross-system testing with EARS interface specs
### Specialized Workflows 16. **bug-hunting** - Issue detection with reproducible specifications 17. **feature-development** - End-to-end feature with EARS requirements 18. **infrastructure-as-code** - IaC with specification-driven compliance 19. **data-pipeline** - ETL with spec-driven data quality requirements 20. **custom-prompt** - User-defined workflow with EARS format requirements
## 📋 Spec-Driven Foundation
### 5-Phase Workflow Process ``` PHASE 1: PLAN → Establish project scope and objectives PHASE 2: REQUIREMENTS → EARS format specification ("WHEN... THEN...") PHASE 3: DESIGN → System architecture and component design PHASE 4: TASKS → Granular task breakdown with acceptance criteria PHASE 5: EXECUTE → TDD cycle implementation (Red → Green → Refactor) ```
### EARS Requirements Format ``` WHEN [trigger condition] THEN the system SHALL [required response]
Examples: - WHEN user enters incorrect credentials three times THEN system SHALL lock account for 15 minutes - WHEN API endpoint is called THEN system SHALL return response within 200ms - WHEN code is committed THEN system SHALL run full test suite automatically ```
## 👑 Leadership Roles Per Workflow
### Queen Bee/Workflow Coordinator Responsibilities - **Phase Management**: Oversees all 5 phases with approval authority - **Team Coordination**: Manages agent assignments and performance - **Quality Assurance**: Ensures deliverable standards and validation - **Stakeholder Communication**: Reports progress and manages expectations - **Escalation Management**: Handles issues beyond team authority
### Decision Authority Matrix ``` Master Orchestrator: ├── Cross-workflow priorities and resource allocation ├── System architecture and infrastructure decisions ├── Budget and capacity planning └── Strategic direction and vision
Workflow Coordinator: ├── Workflow execution decisions within scope ├── Team composition and agent assignment ├── Quality standards and acceptance criteria └── Timeline and milestone management
Specialized Managers: ├── Domain-specific technical decisions ├── Process and methodology implementation ├── Quality assurance within specialty └── Team member development and performance ```
## 🔧 GitHub Integration
### Automatic Project Management - **Issue Creation**: Automatic GitHub issues for each workflow phase - **PR Management**: Agent-generated PRs with proper linking and reviews - **Project Boards**: Synchronized kanban boards in GitHub Projects - **Milestone Tracking**: Automatic milestone updates based on progress - **OAuth Integration**: Seamless authentication with your GitHub account
### Workflow Visualization in GitHub ``` GitHub Issue: "Generate comprehensive API documentation" ├── Planning Phase → Label: "phase:planning" ├── Requirements Phase → Label: "phase:requirements" ├── Design Phase → Label: "phase:design" ├── Tasks Phase → Label: "phase:tasks" ├── Execute Phase → Label: "phase:execute" └── Completion → Closed with linked PR ```
## 🎯 Quick Start
### Prerequisites - Rust (latest stable) - Node.js (>=18) - pnpm (>=8) - Tmux installed - GitHub account with OAuth setup - Cortex Memory system running
### Installation ```bash # Clone the repository git clone <repository-url> cd enhanced-tmux-orchestrator
# Install Vibe Kanban npx vibe-kanban
# Setup GitHub OAuth # Configure workspace for orchestrator integration
# Start Cortex Memory Backend cd /path/to/cortex-complete ./start_cortex.sh
# Initialize Master Orchestrator ./start-master-orchestrator.sh ```
### Basic Usage ```bash # Start a workflow with leadership ./orchestrator create-workflow documentation-generation --with-coordinator
# Check all workflow status ./orchestrator status --all
# Add agents to existing workflow ./orchestrator add-agent <workflow-id> --role=technical-writer
# Scale team for complex workflow ./orchestrator scale-team <workflow-id> --size=5 --with-specialists ```
## 🔬 Advanced Features
### Dynamic Orchestrator Decision-Making - **auto-workflow**: Orchestrator analyzes context and selects optimal workflow - **adaptive-workflow**: Creates hybrid workflows combining multiple patterns - **learning-workflow**: System learns from past successes and improves patterns
### Agent Management Commands ```bash # Dynamic agent management ./orchestrator add-agent <role> <specialization> ./orchestrator add-team <workflow> <size> ./orchestrator remove-agent <agent-id> ./orchestrator scale-team <team-id> <new-size> ./orchestrator reassign-agent <agent-id> <new-role> ./orchestrator merge-teams <team1> <team2> ```
### Custom Workflow Creation ```bash # Create custom workflow with specifications ./orchestrator create-custom-workflow \ --name="custom-integration" \ --objective="Integrate third-party API" \ --agents="api-specialist,integration-tester,documentation-writer" \ --success-criteria="100% test coverage, full documentation" \ --ears-requirements="custom-requirements.md" ```
## 📊 Monitoring & Analytics
### Vibe Kanban Dashboard Views - **Master Dashboard**: System health, capacity, workflow pipeline - **Coordinator Dashboard**: Team performance, phase progress, quality metrics - **Agent View**: Current assignments, coordinator messages, performance feedback
### Real-time Progress Tracking - Visual workflow state transitions - Agent activity and productivity metrics - GitHub integration status and PR tracking - Cross-workflow dependency management - Bottleneck identification and resolution
## 🏆 Benefits
### Enterprise-Grade Capabilities - **24/7 Autonomous Operation**: Persistent tmux sessions with memory continuity - **Proper Leadership**: Clear authority and accountability at every level - **Quality Assurance**: Spec-driven development with phase gate approvals - **Full Observability**: Real-time monitoring and GitHub integration - **Learning Intelligence**: Cortex memory enables continuous improvement
### Development Acceleration - **87 Claude Flow MCP Tools**: Comprehensive AI toolkit for all workflows - **20 Specialized Workflows**: Proven patterns for every development scenario - **Dynamic Team Formation**: Right-sized teams with appropriate specialists - **Automated GitHub Integration**: Seamless project management and tracking - **Cross-Session Persistence**: No context loss across system restarts
